tasks.detail: 类型检查 / 静态编译：gradle compileJava（不打包）
tasks.command: $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Users\Administrator\.jdks\temurin-17'; $g=(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.gradle\wrapper\dists\gradle-8.14.5-bin" -Recurse -Filter gradle.bat | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; if (-not $g) { Write-Error 'gradle 8.14.5 not found in wrapper dists'; exit 1 }; & $g compileJava --console=plain; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: mc_build
tasks.detail: 编译打包并把 jar 部署到 .minecraft/mods
tasks.command: $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Users\Administrator\.jdks\temurin-17'; $g=(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.gradle\wrapper\dists\gradle-8.14.5-bin" -Recurse -Filter gradle.bat | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; & $g build --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $jar=(Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}/mod/build/libs/hexalunar_calamity-*.jar' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; Copy-Item $jar 'C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\.minecraft\versions\1.20.1-Forge_47.4.23-2\mods' -Force; Write-Host "DEPLOYED -> $jar"
